title: Billing Standard Clause: Charges Billed Since a Payment Arrangements Offer and the Down Payment Paid
content:
**Billing standard, clause on charges billed since the offer — Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements)**

**Clause.** Before the excess of the down payment is reckoned, the down payment paid first settles a charge billed on the member's Electric Service by Rate Schedule account on or after the offer date:

- where a late payment charge was billed on or after the offer date, the latest such late payment charge is set aside from the down payment paid;
- where no such late payment charge was billed but a service fee was, the latest such service fee is set aside from it;
- where neither was billed, nothing is set aside for charges billed since the offer.

One charge at most is set aside: the latest late payment charge where there is one since the offer, otherwise the latest service fee since the offer. *Latest* is by the date the charge was billed.

| Late payment charge billed on or after the offer date | Service fee billed on or after the offer date | Set aside from the down payment paid |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | the latest such late payment charge |
| yes | no | the latest such late payment charge |
| no | yes | the latest such service fee |
| no | no | nothing |

**Hypothetical charges after an offer dated August 4:** a service fee of $20.00 billed August 6 and a late payment charge of $7.25 billed August 9 — $7.25 is set aside. Had the only late payment charge been billed August 1, before the offer, the $20.00 service fee would be set aside.
